title: On Selmer complexes, Stark systems and derived $p$-adic heights
summary: We develop the theory of Nekovář's Selmer complexes. We prove that, under mild hypotheses, Nekovář's Selmer complexes are canonically quasi-isomorphic to ``Poitou-Tate complexes", which arise from Poitou-Tate global duality exact sequences. We give two applications. Firstly, we prove that the determinant of a Selmer complex is canonically isomorphic to the module of Stark systems and, by using this result, we construct a canonical ``Heegner point Stark system" which controls Selmer groups.
